name: Goth Gasp
source:
When your girlfriend Mia gets fired right after closing the biggest deal in her company’s history, the two of you are forced to start over in a new city.
With nothing but bad timing and reckless optimism, your only chance at survival is building a business from scratch.

What kind of business? No idea. How it’s supposed to work? Even less.
But the “Department of Unclear Goals” won’t run itself.

While Mia hustles on her end, your job is to secure new contacts - which, in practice, means meeting strange new people, earning their trust (or not), and convincing them to work with you by any questionable means available.

The rest? That’s for you to discover.
translation:
当你的女朋友米娅在完成公司历史上最大的一笔交易后被解雇时，你们两个被迫在一个新的城市重新开始。
除了糟糕的时机和鲁莽的乐观态度之外，你唯一的生存机会就是从头开始建立一家企业。

什么样的生意？不知道。它应该如何运作？甚至更少。
但“目标不明确部门”不会自行运行。

当米娅忙忙碌碌时，你的工作是争取新的联系——这实际上意味着结识陌生的新人，赢得他们的信任（或不信任），并通过任何可疑的方式说服他们与你合作。

其余的部分？这有待你去发现。
